variables.description: Source whose successful account aggregation starts the follow-up load. Use the source id from Admin > Connections > Sources.
variables.name: triggerSource

variables.description: Source to account-aggregate after the trigger source succeeds. Use the source id from Admin > Connections > Sources.
variables.name: followUpSource

variables.description: ISC API base URL used by the follow-up aggregation request (no trailing slash).
variables.name: url

Define Variable.description: Set triggerSource, followUpSource, and url before enabling. Variable names must stay camelCase: the step output is keyed by variable name and later steps reference $.defineVariable.<name>. The event trigger cannot read these values, so matching happens in the next step.

Check Trigger Source.description: Continue only when the completed aggregation is for the configured Trigger Source.

End Step - Skipped.description: The completed aggregation was for a different source. No follow-up aggregation was started.

End Step - Success.description: The follow-up source account aggregation was accepted.

End Step - Failure.description: The follow-up source account aggregation request failed.

HTTP Request 1.description: Starts an optimized account aggregation on the configured followUpSource.

name: Chain source aggregation
description: When account aggregation completes successfully, start account aggregation on a second source. Set triggerSource, followUpSource, and url in Configuration, then attach OAuth on the HTTP Request before enabling.
